mapper.sql: ebook_id, user_id, pilgrimage_id, ebook_type, snapshot_hash, milestone, status, pdf_key, epub_key, fail_reason, page_count, byte_size, retry_count, building_started_at, queued_at, built_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ebook (user_id, pilgrimage_id, ebook_type, milestone, status, queued_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{pilgrimageId}, #{ebookType}, #{milestone}, 'REQUESTED', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ebook WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ebook_type = #{ebookType} AND IFNULL(milestone, 0) = IFNULL(#{milestone}, 0) AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'READY') LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ebook WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ebook_type = #{ebookType} AND pilgrimage_id IS NULL AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'READY') LIMIT 1

SELECT e.ebook_id, e.user_id, e.pilgrimage_id, c.course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.ebook_type, e.milestone, e.status, e.pdf_key, e.epub_key, e.fail_reason, e.page_count, e.byte_size, e.created_at FROM ebook e LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = e.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ebook SET pdf_key = COALESCE(#{pdfKey}, pdf_key), epub_key = COALESCE(#{epubKey}, epub_key), status = 'READY', built_at = NOW(), fail_reason = NULL WHERE ebook_id = #{ebookId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ebook WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND snapshot_hash = #{snapshotHash}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebook WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND snapshot_hash IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebook WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'READY' AND snapshot_hash IS NOT NULL AND DATE(built_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebook (user_id, pilgrimage_id, ebook_type, snapshot_hash, status, queued_at) VALUES (#{userId}, NULL, 'PERSONAL', #{snapshotHash}, 'REQUESTED', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ebook WHERE ebook_id = #{ebookId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ebook SET status = 'READY', pdf_key = #{pdfKey}, page_count = #{pageCount}, byte_size = #{byteSize}, built_at = NOW(), fail_reason = NULL WHERE ebook_id = #{ebookId}
mapper.select: SELECT ebook_id FROM ebook WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY queued_at, ebook_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM ( SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.built_at DESC, e.ebook_id DESC) AS rn FROM ebook e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = 'READY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM print_order po WHERE po.ebook_id = e.ebook_id AND po.status <> 'CANCELED') ) t WHERE t.rn > #{keep} ORDER BY t.built_at, t.ebook_id

SELECT e.ebook_id, e.user_id, e.pilgrimage_id, c.course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.ebook_type, e.milestone, e.status, e.pdf_key, e.epub_key, e.fail_reason, e.page_count, e.byte_size, e.created_at FROM ebook e LEFT JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = e.pilgrimage_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE e.ebook_id = #{ebookId}
